name: StoreViq Analytics Connector
author: StoreViq

sections.description:
StoreViq turns your WooCommerce data into clear, actionable insights — powered by AI.

Connect your store in minutes and get:

  • 📊 Revenue dashboards — daily trends, totals, and average order value
  • 🛍️ Product analytics — top sellers, units sold, revenue by product
  • 👥 Customer intelligence — repeat rate, lifetime value, top spenders
  • 🤖 AI Chat — ask questions about your store in plain English, get charts and answers instantly
  • 💡 AI Recommendations — personalised, data-driven action items to grow your store
  • 🔄 Real-time sync — orders push to StoreViq the moment they are created or updated

How it works

  1. Create a free StoreViq account at storeviq.com
  2. Connect your WooCommerce store
  3. Install this plugin and paste your API key
  4. Done — your data syncs automatically from now on

Privacy

This plugin sends order data (order totals, product names, customer email, billing name) to the StoreViq service. No payment card data is ever transmitted. See storeviq.com/privacy for the full privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the storeviq-connector folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin in Plugins → Installed Plugins
  3. Go to WooCommerce → StoreViq
  4. Paste your API key from your StoreViq Settings page
  5. Click Save Settings
sections.faq:
Where do I get my API key?

Log in to storeviq.com, go to Dashboard → Settings, and copy the Plugin API Key.

Does it slow down my checkout?

No. The plugin sends order data asynchronously (fire-and-forget) so your checkout speed is never affected.

What data is sent to StoreViq?

Order ID, status, date, total amounts, product names and quantities, and customer billing name and email. No payment card data is ever sent.

Can I sync historical orders?

Yes. Go to WooCommerce → StoreViq and click Sync All Orders Now to push all existing orders.

Is it compatible with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. The plugin declares full compatibility with WooCommerce’s Custom Order Tables feature.
